evidence: verl/trainer/main_ppo.py:193 "Legacy trainer `main_ppo_v0.py` is deprecated, and wil be removed in v0.9.0."
verl/trainer/ppo/ray_trainer.py:285 @deprecated("Legacy trainer is deprecated, and wil be removed in v0.9.0. Please use `trainer.use_v1=True` instead.")

docs/advance/determinism.md:104 Full determinism requires the **V0** trainer backend (`trainer.use_v1=false`, i.e. `AgentLoopManager`). The default V1 backend (`AgentLoopManagerTQ`) decouples rollout submission from collection via a fire-and-forget TransferQueue: outputs are collected **in completion order**, which depends on per-request latency and varies across runs, so the output concatenation order (and thus the training batch) differs run-to-run. V0 instead uses `asyncio.gather`, which returns outputs in **submission order** — stable across runs.

旧 RL TaskRunner 与完整 RayPPOTrainer；仍承载 full_determinism 路径。

evidence: verl/trainer/main_ppo.py:193 "Legacy trainer `main_ppo_v0.py` is deprecated, and wil be removed in v0.9.0."
verl/trainer/ppo/ray_trainer.py:285 @deprecated("Legacy trainer is deprecated, and wil be removed in v0.9.0. Please use `trainer.use_v1=True` instead.")

docs/advance/determinism.md:104 Full determinism requires the **V0** trainer backend (`trainer.use_v1=false`, i.e. `AgentLoopManager`). The default V1 backend (`AgentLoopManagerTQ`) decouples rollout submission from collection via a fire-and-forget TransferQueue: outputs are collected **in completion order**, which depends on per-request latency and varies across runs, so the output concatenation order (and thus the training batch) differs run-to-run. V0 instead uses `asyncio.gather`, which returns outputs in **submission order** — stable across runs.
